missing_fields: Complete four-page main only; cited full sources and any SI unreviewed.
Raw alloy preparation, individual elemental charges, suppliers, melt-spinning temperature, wheel speed, atmosphere and cooling rate are not reported.
Anneal ramp/cooling history, specimen dimensions beyond the precursor ribbon thickness, vacuum equipment and physical batch identifiers are not reported.
The material composition is Fe90Zr7B3, with α-Fe nanograins and intercrystalline regions. No phase-pure Fe90Zr7B3 crystal or measured interface atom coordinates are asserted.
Mean grain sizes are diffraction/Rietveld quantities confirmed by TEM; no TEM image, particle-shape distribution, ligand or isolated colloidal-particle diameter is supplied.
Interface thickness and separated phonon spectra depend on author models and assumptions; they are not direct atomic images.
Source-specific morphology and unit-cell illustrations remain presentation pending; no measured coordinate asset supplied.
